name: print-social-pastel-glass-cards-encryption-billboard-triptych
title: Pastel Glass Billboard Triptych
whatItIs: Three lightbox posters on a grey tiled wall: glass debit cards on a pastel blue and peach gradient with a credit score note, concentric glass discs with a lock and the line 'Your data protected by advanced encryption', and a frosted banking app phone with 'All your finances simplified in one place'.
whatItMeans: Frosted pastel gradients feel secure yet gentle, and each poster illustrates its message with a glassy object.
techniques: Glass objects as the hero of each poster
Pastel peach and blue gradient fields
Short centred headline at the top
Lightbox frames on a neutral wall

vocabulary.definition: A backlit poster in a box frame.
Nested circles used to suggest layers of protection.
A translucent 3D shape used as an illustration.
